Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *

How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Yes. I was out late because I was on a plan during the registration. This meant all the classes I wanted were filled up, but I talked to the professors and ended up getting all the classes I wanted.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Be out in better time than me. But if you talk to the professors it can be solved.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: It was lower than in DK, because they take courses in different disciplines. However, I enjoyed taking non-econ courses.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: A lot better, really small classes. 10-15 people to a professor.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
International trade
Introduction to public policy
Epistemology and methodology

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: I really enjoyed epistemology and methodology (a philosophy course). It was transferred as VT, and was fun trying something completely different.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Try to not only socialise with other danish people. Easy to meet local people and part of the experience.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Openness, easy to talk to new people.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Do it, but be aware it is expensive. 
Stay at uni all 10 weeks and travel after and before. 
Use all the crazy facilities, you will not get that opportunity again.
